asset.title: Live Convex Broad Proof 20260620
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser proof clip. Judge only visible product evidence: multi-client sync, advisory presence, no-clobber behavior, proposals, job/privacy/wall surfaces, and production honesty.

judge.summary: The video provides a comprehensive live browser demonstration of the NodeRoom diligence environment, showcasing multi-client sync, spreadsheet editing, agent interaction, and the room trace log.

featureClarity.evidence: Demonstrates navigation across the room binder, sticky note wall, and Q3 variance spreadsheet.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Shows the full sequence from entering the room to editing cells and observing trace updates.

visualDesign.evidence: High-density dark mode interface with clear active states, though slightly cluttered.

consistency.evidence: Perfectly aligns with the NodeRoom ecosystem of spreadsheets, walls, agents, and traces.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Authentic live browser capture showing real-time UI updates and state changes.

legibility.evidence: Small font sizes in the trace log and chat panels make reading difficult at standard resolutions.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Highly relevant to financial analysts and bankers managing diligence workflows.

productionHonesty.evidence: Accurately reflects real-time system latency and agent proposal states.

defects.observed: The text in the bottom room trace log is very small and has low contrast, making it hard to read.
defects.fix: Increase the font size or contrast of the trace log text.

defects.observed: The transition from the landing page to the room binder is extremely rapid.
defects.fix: Add a slight pause or smoother transition when entering the room.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Live demonstration of the NodeRoom banking diligence war room, featuring real-time spreadsheet collaboration, agent proposals, and automated trace logging.
